deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words ('here', 'This') into a spatial relation ('lies next to') that was not stated by the lecturer.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The word 'circumspect' was replaced with 'circumscribed', but no such correction was listed in the term corrections.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate

considerations.sourcePassage: Movable, and literally, you can scoop it out with no damage to the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: Expanding the fragmented phrasing into a complete grammatical clause ('the tumour is movable, and it can literally be scooped out...') is an allowed change of style and grammar.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue
considerations.reason: 'has, in a sense, invaded this tissue' faithfully captures the lecturer's qualification 'if you like'.

considerations.sourcePassage: but you wouldn't be sampling all over the body
considerations.reason: 'the whole body would not be sampled' carries the exact same meaning in a passive construction.
